image_description: A close-up underwater photograph of a chiton (polyplacophore) clinging to a rocky substrate. The subject displays the characteristic eight overlapping dorsal plates embedded in a textured, leathery girdle. The surrounding environment consists of encrusted rock with reddish and greenish marine growth.
